headline: Russia Launchs Massive Drone Barrage on Kyiv Infrastructure as Iran Advances Underground Missile Production
subheadline: Over 350 Shahed drones launched from Kursk as Geran-5 missile strikes Kyiv's CHP-5 plant, while southern Lebanon faces intense daily bombardment.
lede: Russia launched a massive drone offensive with over 350 Shahed drones from Kursk over 11 hours, targeting central and western Ukraine, with a Geran-5 missile directly striking Kyiv's CHP-5 thermal power plant. In the Middle East, Iran is advancing its underground missile production at Khojir by excavating a new entrance, even as nuclear negotiations with the U.S. show partial progress but persistent distrust. Lebanon faced intense daily bombardment on October 31 with 47 artillery strikes and 8 air strikes across southern districts, while Hamas tunnel footage revealed the full General Military Council behind the October 7 attack, all confirmed killed. Meanwhile, the U.S. CENTCOM reported redirecting 144 commercial vessels enforcing the blockade against Iran, and an AP investigation found over 115 Iranian strikes damaged structures at 26 U.S. military sites.
